widths.mainText: WALL STREET THINKING. BUILT FOR MAIN STREET TRADERS. Stock & Options Trading Concepts, Mentorship & Proposed Tools You Finally Found What You’ve Been Searching For. Zero Hype. People Over Profits. Tired of expensive promises, hindsight screenshots, and indicators that look perfect only after the move? Revolution Trading Pros is built around a different idea: practical education, transparent trade planning, defined risk, and a genuine commitment to people. Founder Billy Ribeiro reports being mentored by Mark “Goldfinger” McGoldrick, who he says called him “the future of trading.” That is the founder’s own account, not an independent endorsement. Read the background and context on our About page. “Educate. Innovate. Prosper.” Wall Street Protects Its Own. We Are the Revolution. Explore Membership Concepts Meet the Founder Concept only · purchases unavailable. Trading can result in substantial losses, including loss of the entire amount invested. THE EXECUTION DOSSIER / 001 Our documentation standard RISK FIRST MARKET STRUCTURE / CONCEPTUAL NOT LIVE PRICE DATA How every idea is documented. 01 Primary sources, cited Contract specifications, settlement rules, and tax references cite primary sources such as Cboe, CME Group, the SEC, FINRA, the OSC, and IRS documentation.02 Risk stated before reward No strategy, indicator, or alert service is presented as a guaranteed return. Setups state invalidation levels, position-sizing limits, and realistic drawdown risk.03 Education, not advice Content is for educational purposes only and is not personalized investment advice. Trading involves substantial risk of loss. Read the editorial policy MARKETS COVERED Stocks. ETFs. Options.STARTING CAPITAL Small-account education from $500+BUILT AROUND YOU Day. Swing. Video Alerts.CORE PRINCIPLE People First. Risk Always. PEOPLE OVER PROFITS / THE ANTI-HYPE STANDARD Not another trading guru. A different standard. If you’ve been burned by expensive courses, unreliable signals, or after-the-fact trade screenshots, you deserve a more useful alternative: clear education, accountability, accessible options, and risk-aware trade plans. WHAT YOU LEAVE BEHIND / THE HYPE TRAP Less storytelling after the trade. More clarity before it. “Holy grail” indicators Signals that shift after the candle closes or imply impossible certainty. Overpriced, recycled theory Large fees attached to generic concepts without practical, testable application. Hindsight-only win screenshots Wins posted without original plans, position risk, or losing-trade context. One-size-fits-all trading Strategies that overlook different account sizes, time constraints, and experience levels. WHAT WE AIM TO DELIVER / THE REVOLUTION STANDARD Pre-planned setups. Honest education. A path that fits. Accessible membership choices Different service levels designed around the help you actually need. Market-structure education Price, liquidity, volume, options mechanics, and the reasoning behind trade decisions. Entries, targets & invalidation levels A stated trading thesis and defined exit criteria before a setup is considered actionable. Services for multiple schedules Live day trading, swing planning, small-account education, and video alerts. ENGINEERED FOR DIFFERENT TRADERS Your time. Your capital. Your next step. You don’t need to fit a single trader stereotype. Start with the format and education that match your life while staying realistic about the risks. 09–05 BUSY CAREERS Working Professionals & Swing Traders For full-time schedules: pre-planned swing ideas and video watchlists with entries, exits, and invalidation levels that can be reviewed outside the live session. Explore swing & watchlists $500+ SMALL ACCOUNT EDUCATION Small-Account Traders ($500+) Learn position sizing, options contract risk, settlement rules, and how to protect limited capital. A $500 account is not a promise of sustainable profits. View small-account program 9:30–4:00 LIVE INTRADAY EXECUTION Active Day Traders & Scalpers Follow real-time market context, chart sharing, trade planning, and position management for stocks, ETFs, and options during active sessions. Explore the day trading room PRO ADVANCED TRADERS Experienced & Full-Time Traders Go deeper into execution process, repeatability, custom tools, and structured 1-on-1 review through a selective mentorship program. Explore the mentorship concept PROPOSED ROOMS / MENTORSHIP / VIDEO ALERTS Four concepts in development. One people-first philosophy. Whether you trade actively at the opening bell, work a full-time 9-to-5 schedule, manage a small account, or prefer prepared video watchlists, explore proposed membership paths built around your goals and risk parameters. Concept only · purchases and paid subscriptions are unavailable. Features shown below are proposed. MEMBERSHIP / 01 DAY TRADERS · SCALPERS · PROS Day Trading Room: Live Stock & Options Execution A proposed virtual learning room exploring market preparation, voice commentary, chart sharing, and risk education. No live room access or paid enrollment is available. Live pre-market preparation: key levels, catalysts, and stock/options trading scenarios before the open. Real-time voice & screen sharing: hear and see decision-making, entries, scaling, and stop management. Stocks & options intraday setups: identify potential momentum trades and options structures with clear risk. Live education as we trade: understand the thesis, the invalidation, and when no trade is the right trade. Explore the Day Trading Room concept MEMBERSHIP / 02 WORKING PROFESSIONALS Swing Trading Room: Multi-Day Stock & Options Setups Built for people who cannot watch charts all day. Plan multi-day and multi-week stock and options ideas around a career and personal life. 9-to-5-friendly trade planning: setup briefs that help you evaluate conditional orders around your schedule. Entry, target & stop levels: defined zones, potential exits, and trade invalidation before the setup triggers. Rotation & macro context: lessons about market cycles, relative strength, and volatility. Evening & weekly video breakdowns: digestible reviews of planned swing scenarios and positions. Explore Swing Trading Room MEMBERSHIP / 03 STARTING ACCOUNTS FROM $500+ Small Accounts Room: Risk-First Mentorship ($500+) A dedicated educational track for traders working with limited capital. The priority is understanding risk, not promising fast or guaranteed account growth. Appropriately sized setups: learn how stock and options exposure interacts with smaller account sizes. Capital-preservation rules: position sizing, maximum loss, and why a single trade must never define your account. Account rules education: understand settlement, margin, and applicable pattern day-trading requirements. Structured learning roadmap: build habits, review mistakes, and develop a repeatable process. Explore Small Accounts Room MEMBERSHIP / 04 SPX PROFIT PULSE · SUNDAY ALPHA PROTOCOL Alert Services: SPX Profit Pulse & Sunday Alpha Protocol Want planned stock and options setups without a live room? Review the video thesis, intended trigger areas, targets, and invalidation in your own time. Detailed video watchlists: setups explained with charts, market context, and relevant catalysts. Planned entries, exits & stops: trigger zones, potential profit levels, and invalidation points. Timely setup alerts: updates across SPX Profit Pulse and Sunday Alpha Protocol when monitored levels trigger. Lower-commitment access: prepared ideas for members who do not need live voice commentary. Explore Alert Services PROPOSED MENTORSHIP / CONCEPT PREVIEW Private 1-on-1 Mentorship. Enrollment is not available. Personal mentoring should be built on genuine fit, mutual commitment, and realistic objectives. Our founder’s reported personal mentorship experience inspired this proposed program. This is a proposed application workflow for future development. No applications, paid enrollment, or private sessions are currently available. No launch or future access is guaranteed. The standard is commitment to the process—not the size of your credit card. Proposed features include educational video explanations, charts, scenario levels, and risk discussion. Applications and paid enrollment are not open. The page describes a possible future application workflow only. No purchase, reservation, or acceptance is created by browsing or requesting updates. h1:
Live Stock, ETF & Options Day Trading Room • Real-Time Voice & Screen Share Stop Trading Alone Against Wall Street Algorithms. Trade the Opening Bell Live With Our
						Desk.
widths.mainText: Proposed concept, not an available service. The features, packages, schedules, platform support, charts, signals, and workflows below are development proposals or illustrative demonstrations. They are not live services, verified product capabilities, or an invitation to purchase or enroll. No price, release date, or future availability is guaranteed. Home Day Trading Room Live Voice & Screen Share • Stocks, ETFs & Options • US & Canada People Over Profits Mentored by Former Goldman Sachs Legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick Live Stock, ETF & Options Day Trading Room • Real-Time Voice & Screen Share Stop Trading Alone Against Wall Street Algorithms. Trade the Opening Bell Live With Our Desk. When you log into our Live Day Trading Room, you immediately know you finally found what you have been searching for: not a chaotic text chat shouting out hindsight tickers, and not a fake guru peddling repainted "holy grail" indicators, but real-time institutional execution with live voice, live screen sharing, and 100% transparency. I know how painful it is to sit on the losing end of day trading, because I stood there myself in the past. I watched how typical chatrooms operate: moderators front-running illiquid penny stocks so members become their exit liquidity, or posting winning screenshots after the close without ever mentioning a stop-loss. That is why I built Revolution Trading Pros around one unbreakable rule: we put people over profits. Directly mentored by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading giant Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who explicitly called me "the future of trading", I brought institutional order-flow discipline to self-directed traders: calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, and executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade during high-volume institutional distribution for a reported 600% overnight gain (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results). Every morning, we bring that exact institutional order-flow playbook live to your screen. "Educate, Innovate, and Prosper. You don't just copy tickers here—you watch our screens live, hear our exact thesis before the trigger hits, and master institutional risk control." Explore the Day Trading Room Concept See Our Daily Bell-to-Bell Routine Instruments Traded Liquid Stocks, ETFs & Options Execution Format Live Voice, Screen Share & Alerts Risk Architecture Exact Entries, Targets & Stops Session Archive Daily Replays & Trade Recaps Live Trading Floor Telemetry How Every Live Trade Is Structured Zero Hindsight We never yell "Buy now!" without a plan. Before we ever click a button on screen, every day trade and scalp in the room is mapped out using five mandatory institutional parameters: 01 // Institutional Thesis & Catalyst Pre-Trade Read Live screen-share breakdown of where retail traders are trapped, where institutional liquidity sits, and why the setup has asymmetric expectancy. 02 // Exact Entry Trigger Zone Price & Volume The exact key level, liquidity sweep, or volume confirmation required to trigger entry, plus the exact options strike and expiration we are selecting. 03 // Hard Invalidation Stop-Loss Capital Protection Stated out loud before entry. You always know the exact dollar and chart level where the thesis is wrong so one loss never damages your account. 04 // Tiered Profit Scaling Targets Target 1 • Target 2 • Runner Mechanical profit-taking zones where we scale out to lock in green cash flow and trail stops on remaining runners into institutional supply/demand. Starting with a $500 account? See our dedicated Small Accounts Room → Structured Daily Routine • Repeatable Process Inside a Live Market Day on Our Trading Floor Amateurs show up at 9:29 AM guessing what to buy. Professionals execute a calm, repeatable four-stage routine every single market day: Stage 01 // Pre-Market Bell Prep Institutional Level Mapping Pre-Market Game Plan, Macro Catalysts & High-Conviction Watchlist Long before the 9:30 AM ET opening bell rings, we map overnight institutional liquidity pools, key gamma and volume levels, economic catalysts, and our top stock, ETF, and options setups for the session. What You Get in This Window: Exact pre-market support, resistance, and institutional liquidity sweep zones Focused watchlist of high-liquidity stocks, ETFs, and options contracts (zero illiquid penny-stock traps) If/Then scenario mapping so you know our exact trigger prices before the market opensStage 02 // Opening Bell Execution Live Voice & Screen Share Real-Time Opening Drive, Momentum Scalping & Options Order Flow Trade the highest-velocity window of the market alongside our desk with live voice commentary and real-time screen sharing. Watch our charts, non-repainting indicators, and order-flow scanners update tick by tick. What You Get in This Window: Live voice callouts explaining the exact thesis BEFORE entry triggers are hit Defined-risk execution with exact entry price, tiered profit targets, and hard invalidation stops Real-time options contract selection (strike, expiration, and implied volatility discipline)Stage 03 // Midday Structure & Rotation Capital Preservation & Trend Midday Institutional Accumulation, Reversals & Patience Discipline Most retail day traders give back their morning profits between 11:30 AM and 2:00 PM ET by overtrading chop. We show you how to protect morning gains, spot institutional midday accumulation, and wait for A+ setups. What You Get in This Window: Live discipline enforcement: knowing when to press size and when to sit flat on your hands Tracking sector rotation, market breadth, and institutional block flow into the afternoon session Live member Q&A and chart diagnostics while price consolidatesStage 04 // Power Hour & Post-Bell Autopsy Review & Replay Archive Closing Bell Order Flow, Trade Autopsies & Full Session Replays Whether we bank a massive green session or manage a disciplined stop, every trade is reviewed transparently. Missed the morning session? Full recordings and level recaps are archived for on-demand study. What You Get in This Window: Power Hour institutional positioning and overnight risk assessment Transparent post-trade breakdown of both winning setups and stopped-out trades On-demand session replays so traders in any time zone never miss a lesson Goldman Sachs Mentored Order Flow • Zero Repainting The Four Institutional Intraday Setups We Trade Live We don’t chase random 1-minute candles or rely on fake "holy grail" arrows. Every trade in the Day Trading Room belongs to one of four high-expectancy institutional setups: Setup 01 // Liquidity Sweep Reversals Stocks, ETFs & Options Opening Bell Institutional Liquidity Traps & Failed Breakouts The Market Structure & Retail Trap: Retail traders chase obvious pre-market highs or lows right at the open, walking straight into institutional sell or buy programs. Our Live Institutional Execution: Using the proprietary order-flow principles passed down by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, we wait for retail stops to get swept, confirm institutional absorption on our non-repainting indicators, and execute the reversal. Risk & Stop-Loss Protocol: Tight, mechanical stop-loss placed directly beyond the liquidity sweep extreme for asymmetric 3R to 5R reward-to-risk.Setup 02 // High-Velocity Options Scalping Intraday Calls, Puts & Spreads Momentum Ignition & Gamma Acceleration Scalps The Market Structure & Retail Trap: High-volume expansion on liquid large-cap equities and index ETFs (SPY, QQQ, IWM, NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, META) breaking out of multi-day compression. Our Live Institutional Execution: We select high-liquidity options contracts with tight bid-ask spreads and optimal delta/gamma profiles, capturing rapid intraday premium expansion without holding overnight decay. Risk & Stop-Loss Protocol: Pre-calculated position sizing and tiered profit scaling (locking in partial gains at Target 1 and moving stops to breakeven).Setup 03 // Contrarian Distribution Shorts The +600% OXY Playbook Fading Retail Euphoria Into Institutional Distribution The Market Structure & Retail Trap: Mainstream news or earnings headlines trigger blind retail buying into an already exhausted, overextended chart structure. Our Live Institutional Execution: The exact playbook we used when Warren Buffett bought millions in Occidental Petroleum (OXY) long and we shorted live with OXY Put Options for +600% overnight. We spot heavy institutional selling hiding behind bullish headlines. Risk & Stop-Loss Protocol: Defined-risk put options or strict equity stop-losses above the distribution high, never averaging down on a losing short.Setup 04 // Macro & Sector Inflection Drives 2020 & 2022 Cycle Framework Intraday Trend Days Aligned With Macro Regime Shifts The Market Structure & Retail Trap: FOMC days, CPI releases, or major macro inflection sessions where institutions reprice entire sectors in a single trend day. Our Live Institutional Execution: Grounded in the macro timing methodology that called the 2020 COVID top and bottom and the 2022 bull top and bear bottom, we align intraday trades with the dominant institutional flow instead of fighting the tape. Risk & Stop-Loss Protocol: Trailing structural stops behind institutional 5-minute and 15-minute higher lows (or lower highs) to capture full-session runners. The Anti-Guru Standard • Hard Evidence Why 95% of Day Trading Chatrooms Cause Retail Traders to Blow Up and Why We Built the Opposite Before you join any live trading room in the United States or Canada, compare how typical internet marketers operate versus the institutional standard inside Revolution Trading Pros: Evaluation StandardTypical "Fake Guru" Day Trading ChatroomsRevolution Trading Pros Day Trading RoomPrimary Revenue Motive Profiting off overpriced subscriptions, upsells, and $2,500 repainted indicators. People Over Profits: Affordable access focused 100% on member execution and consistency.Institutional Pedigree Self-proclaimed internet gurus with zero Wall Street training or verifiable macro calls. Mentored by former Goldman Sachs prop legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick ("the future of trading").Markets & Liquidity Illiquid micro-float penny stocks where the host buys first and dumps on the chatroom. Deeply liquid US Stocks, ETFs, and Options where every member gets clean institutional fills.How Trades Are Called Delayed text messages after the move already happened, with no stop-loss mentioned. Live voice & screen share walking through the exact entry trigger, targets, and hard stop ahead of time.Chart Telemetry & Tools Lagging retail oscillators or repainted "holy grail" buy/sell arrows that erase losses. 100% non-repainting institutional indicators, real-time volume/liquidity structure, and order flow. People Over Profits • Honest Fit Check Step Into the Live Day Trading Room or Choose the Exact Room Built for Your Life Because our mission is helping you prosper rather than forcing everyone into a single subscription, make sure you choose the room or alert service that matches your daily schedule and starting capital: You Are Here // Intraday Execution Most Popular For Active Traders Live Day Trading Room Ideal for active day traders, options scalpers, and full-time traders who can attend the morning bell session (or study replays) and want real-time voice, live screen sharing, and intraday stock, ETF, and options execution. Discuss the Day Trading Room Concept Working a Full-Time 9-to-5 Job? Swing Trading Room & Sunday Alpha Protocol Interested in a different schedule? Explore our proposed Swing Trading Room or our affordable Sunday Alpha Protocol video watchlist tier for multi-day setups with pre-planned entries, targets, and stops. Explore the Swing Trading Room Starting With a $500 to $2,500 Account? Small Accounts Room ($500+ Capital) Trading with a smaller balance requires strict contract affordability, cash-account T+1 rotation, and ironclad drawdown rules. Our Small Accounts Room is engineered specifically for accounts starting as low as $500. Explore the Small Accounts Room Direct Answers • Zero Marketing Fluff Frequently Asked Questions About the Live Day Trading Room Do you trade micro-float penny stocks or liquid institutional stocks and options? + The proposed educational scope includes liquid U.S. stocks, ETFs, and options. Liquidity varies and does not guarantee execution, prevent slippage, or eliminate losses. No live room is operating as an available service.Will I actually see your screen and hear your voice live, or is it just text alerts? + Live commentary and screen sharing are proposed features, not currently available room access. Any interface demonstrations are illustrative and do not represent a live session.How does your Goldman Sachs mentorship lineage change how you day trade? + The founder reports a personal mentorship experience. That account does not establish institutional affiliation, endorsement, independently verified performance, or the effectiveness of a proposed service.What if I only want SPX index options alerts or pre-planned video watchlists? + If you prefer dedicated alert-only services without sitting in the full day trading room, explore SPX Profit Pulse for high-precision S&P 500 index options execution or Sunday Alpha Protocol, our accessible video watchlist alert membership delivering exact targeted entries, profit exits, and stop-loss levels.Can I also use your custom non-repainting indicators and scanners alongside the room? + Yes. The exact 100% non-repainting indicators, institutional order-flow scanners, and trading courses you see on our shared screens every morning are available in our Store, alongside our free Options Calculator. Educate • Innovate • Prosper We Are the Present and the Future. We Are the Revolution! Leave fake holy grail indicators, hindsight screenshots, and overpriced guru rooms behind. Step onto a transparent live trading floor built to put people over profits. Explore the Day Trading Room Concept Small Accounts Room ($500+) Explore the Mentorship Concept

You Need a Playbook Built for $500+ Reality. When you log into our Small Accounts Room, you immediately know you finally found what you have been searching for: not a reckless internet marketer telling you to gamble your last $500 on lottery-ticket options, and not an overpriced course that drains your savings, but a disciplined, mathematical roadmap engineered specifically for accounts starting as low as $500. I know how devastating it feels to blow up a small trading account, because I stood on the losing end myself in the past. Most trading rooms destroy small accounts because they call out $1,000+ options contracts meant for six-figure portfolios, where one normal dip wipes out 50% of a beginner's capital. Even worse, fake gurus charge $3,000 for repainted "holy grail" indicators, stealing the very capital you needed to trade with. That is why I built Revolution Trading Pros on one unbreakable rule: we put people over profits. Mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called me "the future of trading", I brought institutional order-flow discipline to self-directed traders: calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, and executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade during high-volume institutional distribution for a reported 600% overnight gain (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results). In this room, we apply that exact institutional discipline to help you protect and compound a $500+ account step by step. "Educate, Innovate, and Prosper. A $500 account traded with Goldman Sachs risk discipline will beat an undisciplined $50,000 gambler every single time. We are the revolution!" Explore the Small Accounts Room Concept See the $500 to $25,000+ Roadmap Starting Capital Built for $500+ Accounts PDT & Settlement T+1 Cash Account Mastery Contract Selection Affordable & High Liquidity Risk Architecture Exact Entries, Targets & Stops Small-Capital Engineering The 4 Laws of $500+ Account Survival Zero Gambling Why do 90% of small accounts fail in their first 30 days? Because they copy big-account sizing. Every setup in our Small Accounts Room obeys four non-negotiable laws: Law 01 // Strict Contract Affordability No Oversized Contracts We filter specifically for liquid stock, ETF, and options setups where contract premiums or vertical spreads fit cleanly inside a $500 to $2,500 budget. Law 02 // T+1 Cash Account Rotation Bypass PDT Locks Learn how to partition your settled cash under T+1 overnight settlement so you can execute intraday setups every morning without needing $25,000 margin. Law 03 // Asymmetric 3R to 5R Payoffs Defined Risk Only By entering at institutional liquidity sweeps with tight invalidation stops, your downside is capped to a small fraction while winners compound aggressively. Law 04 // Pre-Planned Entries, Exits & Stops Zero Guesswork Every trade includes the exact entry trigger, profit target, and hard stop-loss level before we enter, eliminating emotional panic selling. Want to calculate exact contract risk before entering? Use our free Options Calculator → Step-by-Step Capital Scaling • Mathematical Discipline The 4-Stage Small Account Compounding Blueprint ($500 to $25,000+) You don’t grow a $500 account by swinging for home runs on every candle. You grow it by graduating through four distinct capital brackets, each with its own position-sizing and risk rules: Stage 01 // Survival & Stabilization $500 to $1,500 Capital Halting Account Bleed, T+1 Cash Account Rotation & Contract Affordability When you start with $500, a single reckless $300 loss destroys 60% of your buying power and requires a 150% gain just to get back to breakeven. Stage 01 installs ironclad capital protection and teaches you how to rotate settled cash daily under T+1 settlement rules without triggering Pattern Day Trader (PDT) locks. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Strict contract price ceiling so no single option contract consumes your account T+1 Cash Account buying-power partitioning (trading 30% to 50% of settled cash per session) Mandatory hard stop-losses placed in the system the second an order fillsStage 02 // Structured Compounding $1,500 to $5,000 Capital Asymmetric 3R+ Setups, Vertical Spreads & Runner Mechanics Once your base capital is protected and growing, you unlock multi-contract scaling and defined-risk vertical debit/credit spreads. Instead of binary "all-in / all-out" trades, you learn to lock in profit on Contract 1 to finance a risk-free runner. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Transitioning from single-contract entries to 2-contract scale-out structures Using vertical debit spreads to cap maximum dollar risk and neutralize Theta decay Moving stops to breakeven immediately after Target 1 is achievedStage 03 // Multi-Strategy Expansion $5,000 to $15,000 Capital Combining Intraday Liquidity Sweeps With Multi-Day Institutional Swings With a $5,000+ cushion, your account no longer depends solely on intraday scalps. We teach you to allocate a core bucket to multi-day institutional swing setups while keeping a tactical bucket for high-velocity opening bell setups. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Splitting capital between intraday cash-flow setups and multi-day swing runners Applying the macro regime framework behind our 2020 and 2022 top and bottom calls Strict daily drawdown circuit breakers to protect weeks of accumulated gainsStage 04 // Institutional Graduation $15,000 to $25,000+ Capital Crossing the $25,000 Threshold Without Developing Reckless Size Habits Many traders work hard to grow a small account to $25,000, unlock margin day trading, and immediately blow it up by 5x-ing their position size overnight. We guide your transition into full institutional sizing with mathematical precision. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Gradual percentage-based position scaling so emotions never spike with dollar size Full integration with our main Day Trading Room and Swing Trading Room playbooks Portfolio-level hedging using index puts and contrarian distribution setups Goldman Sachs Mentored Execution • Right-Sized for Small Capital Four Institutional Setups Engineered Specifically for $500+ Accounts We never water down our institutional edge for small accounts; we right-size the vehicle. Here are the four core playbooks we execute inside the Small Accounts Room: Playbook 01 // T+1 Cash Account Liquidity Sweeps Liquid Options & ETFs High-Probability Opening Bell Reversals Priced for $500+ Accounts Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Small account traders chase expensive, high-implied-volatility options contracts ($8.00 to $15.00 per contract) right as retail FOMO peaks at the open. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: Using the proprietary order-flow methodology passed down by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, we wait for institutional liquidity sweeps on liquid ETFs and stocks where clean, tight-spread options contracts cost a fraction of the price. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Tight structural invalidation levels just beyond the sweep high/low, keeping dollar risk small while targeting 200% to 300% asymmetric expansions.Playbook 02 // Defined-Risk Vertical Spreads Debit & Credit Spreads Capping Maximum Risk & Defeating Options Time Decay (Theta) Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Beginners buy cheap, far out-of-the-money weekly lottery-ticket calls or puts that have a 95% probability of expiring worthless due to rapid time decay. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: We teach small accounts how to pair a long option with a short option (vertical spreads), drastically lowering the cost of entry, neutralizing time decay, and supporting profitable execution even on moderate price moves. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Maximum possible loss is 100% locked in and known before entry, with zero margin surprises and zero Theta bleed traps.Playbook 03 // Contrarian Distribution Puts The +600% OXY Blueprint Turning Small Defined Risk Into Explosive Gains When Hype Collapses Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Retail traders with $500 accounts buy late into media hype, becoming exit liquidity for billionaires and institutional desks. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: This is the exact blueprint behind our famous Occidental Petroleum (OXY) trade: while Warren Buffett bought millions of dollars on the long side and retail chased the headline, we spotted institutional distribution and bought affordable OXY Put Options live for a 600% overnight gain. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Strictly defined premium risk on liquid put contracts when institutional volume confirms buyer exhaustion at major resistance.Playbook 04 // High-Velocity Small-Cap & ETF Swings Shares & Multi-Day Options Capturing 3-to-5 Day Compression Breakouts Without PDT Restrictions Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Traders in margin accounts under $25,000 get locked by the 3-day-trade Pattern Day Trader (PDT) rule or hold losing day trades overnight hoping to avoid a PDT strike. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: We provide pre-planned 2-to-5 day swing setups with exact entry triggers, profit targets, and hard stops that don’t count as day trades, allowing you to compound smoothly whether you use a cash account or a small margin account. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Pre-calculated share or contract sizing using our free Options Calculator so every trade respects your exact account balance. People Over Profits: Kept genuinely affordable so your hard-earned money stays inside your brokerage account."Small Account Challenge" Honesty Gambles 100% per trade across 10 hidden accounts, blows up 9 in secret, and markets the 1 lucky account on social media. 100% real, repeatable risk management taught by the trader Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick called "the future of trading."Contract Price Selection Calls out $12.00 ($1,200 per contract) options that a $500 to $1,500 account cannot even afford to buy. Hand-selected setups priced specifically for small-account affordability, tight bid-ask spreads, and high liquidity.PDT & T+1 Cash Account Rules Ignores Pattern Day Trader locks and cash settlement rules, leaving small accounts stranded with unsettled funds. Built-in daily buying-power allocation and T+1 cash rotation so you can trade consistently every market day.Pre-Trade Risk Definition Shouts "lotto calls" with zero stop-loss and tells members "only risk what you can afford to lose" when it goes to zero. Every setup specifies the exact entry trigger, tiered profit targets, and hard invalidation stop-loss ahead of time. Get live guidance, affordable stock and options setups, T+1 cash account buying-power rotation, defined-risk vertical spreads, and strict stop-loss discipline. Losses may consume the account. No membership is available.Should I use a Cash Account or a Margin Account if I have less than $25,000? + We teach you how to navigate both. In the United States, a Cash Account is exempt from the Pattern Day Trader (PDT) 3-day-trade limit. Because options and equities settle overnight on a T+1 schedule, your settled cash refreshes every single market morning. If you prefer a small margin account (or trade from Canada where PDT rules differ), we also execute multi-day swing setups and defined-risk spreads.Why do you care about $500 small accounts when you have Goldman Sachs mentorship pedigree? + The small-account concept concerns position sizing and risk awareness. It does not establish suitability or promise a manageable workload or return. No access is offered.What happens once my small account grows past $10,000 or $25,000? + Account growth and progression are not promised. Any roadmap is illustrative, and future programs, eligibility, and access have not been established. Educate • Innovate • Prosper We Are the Present and the Future. We Are the Revolution! h1:
Small Accounts Stock & Options Trading Room • $500+ Compounding & Risk Control You Don’t Need $25,000 to Trade Like an Institution. You Need a Playbook Built for $500+
						Reality.
widths.mainText: Proposed concept, not an available service. The features, packages, schedules, platform support, charts, signals, and workflows below are development proposals or illustrative demonstrations. They are not live services, verified product capabilities, or an invitation to purchase or enroll. No price, release date, or future availability is guaranteed. Home Small Accounts Room Accounts Starting at $500+ • T+1 Cash & PDT Mastery • US & Canada Accounts Starting as Low as $500 People Over Profits • Zero Fake "Holy Grail" Indicators Small Accounts Stock & Options Trading Room • $500+ Compounding & Risk Control You Don’t Need $25,000 to Trade Like an Institution. You Need a Playbook Built for $500+ Reality. When you log into our Small Accounts Room, you immediately know you finally found what you have been searching for: not a reckless internet marketer telling you to gamble your last $500 on lottery-ticket options, and not an overpriced course that drains your savings, but a disciplined, mathematical roadmap engineered specifically for accounts starting as low as $500. I know how devastating it feels to blow up a small trading account, because I stood on the losing end myself in the past. Most trading rooms destroy small accounts because they call out $1,000+ options contracts meant for six-figure portfolios, where one normal dip wipes out 50% of a beginner's capital. Even worse, fake gurus charge $3,000 for repainted "holy grail" indicators, stealing the very capital you needed to trade with. That is why I built Revolution Trading Pros on one unbreakable rule: we put people over profits. Mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called me "the future of trading", I brought institutional order-flow discipline to self-directed traders: calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, and executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade during high-volume institutional distribution for a reported 600% overnight gain (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results). In this room, we apply that exact institutional discipline to help you protect and compound a $500+ account step by step. "Educate, Innovate, and Prosper. A $500 account traded with Goldman Sachs risk discipline will beat an undisciplined $50,000 gambler every single time. We are the revolution!" Explore the Small Accounts Room Concept See the $500 to $25,000+ Roadmap Starting Capital Built for $500+ Accounts PDT & Settlement T+1 Cash Account Mastery Contract Selection Affordable & High Liquidity Risk Architecture Exact Entries, Targets & Stops Small-Capital Engineering The 4 Laws of $500+ Account Survival Zero Gambling Why do 90% of small accounts fail in their first 30 days? Because they copy big-account sizing. Every setup in our Small Accounts Room obeys four non-negotiable laws: Law 01 // Strict Contract Affordability No Oversized Contracts We filter specifically for liquid stock, ETF, and options setups where contract premiums or vertical spreads fit cleanly inside a $500 to $2,500 budget. Law 02 // T+1 Cash Account Rotation Bypass PDT Locks Learn how to partition your settled cash under T+1 overnight settlement so you can execute intraday setups every morning without needing $25,000 margin. Law 03 // Asymmetric 3R to 5R Payoffs Defined Risk Only By entering at institutional liquidity sweeps with tight invalidation stops, your downside is capped to a small fraction while winners compound aggressively. Law 04 // Pre-Planned Entries, Exits & Stops Zero Guesswork Every trade includes the exact entry trigger, profit target, and hard stop-loss level before we enter, eliminating emotional panic selling. Want to calculate exact contract risk before entering? Use our free Options Calculator → Step-by-Step Capital Scaling • Mathematical Discipline The 4-Stage Small Account Compounding Blueprint ($500 to $25,000+) You don’t grow a $500 account by swinging for home runs on every candle. You grow it by graduating through four distinct capital brackets, each with its own position-sizing and risk rules: Stage 01 // Survival & Stabilization $500 to $1,500 Capital Halting Account Bleed, T+1 Cash Account Rotation & Contract Affordability When you start with $500, a single reckless $300 loss destroys 60% of your buying power and requires a 150% gain just to get back to breakeven. Stage 01 installs ironclad capital protection and teaches you how to rotate settled cash daily under T+1 settlement rules without triggering Pattern Day Trader (PDT) locks. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Strict contract price ceiling so no single option contract consumes your account T+1 Cash Account buying-power partitioning (trading 30% to 50% of settled cash per session) Mandatory hard stop-losses placed in the system the second an order fillsStage 02 // Structured Compounding $1,500 to $5,000 Capital Asymmetric 3R+ Setups, Vertical Spreads & Runner Mechanics Once your base capital is protected and growing, you unlock multi-contract scaling and defined-risk vertical debit/credit spreads. Instead of binary "all-in / all-out" trades, you learn to lock in profit on Contract 1 to finance a risk-free runner. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Transitioning from single-contract entries to 2-contract scale-out structures Using vertical debit spreads to cap maximum dollar risk and neutralize Theta decay Moving stops to breakeven immediately after Target 1 is achievedStage 03 // Multi-Strategy Expansion $5,000 to $15,000 Capital Combining Intraday Liquidity Sweeps With Multi-Day Institutional Swings With a $5,000+ cushion, your account no longer depends solely on intraday scalps. We teach you to allocate a core bucket to multi-day institutional swing setups while keeping a tactical bucket for high-velocity opening bell setups. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Splitting capital between intraday cash-flow setups and multi-day swing runners Applying the macro regime framework behind our 2020 and 2022 top and bottom calls Strict daily drawdown circuit breakers to protect weeks of accumulated gainsStage 04 // Institutional Graduation $15,000 to $25,000+ Capital Crossing the $25,000 Threshold Without Developing Reckless Size Habits Many traders work hard to grow a small account to $25,000, unlock margin day trading, and immediately blow it up by 5x-ing their position size overnight. We guide your transition into full institutional sizing with mathematical precision. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Gradual percentage-based position scaling so emotions never spike with dollar size Full integration with our main Day Trading Room and Swing Trading Room playbooks Portfolio-level hedging using index puts and contrarian distribution setups Goldman Sachs Mentored Execution • Right-Sized for Small Capital Four Institutional Setups Engineered Specifically for $500+ Accounts We never water down our institutional edge for small accounts; we right-size the vehicle. Here are the four core playbooks we execute inside the Small Accounts Room: Playbook 01 // T+1 Cash Account Liquidity Sweeps Liquid Options & ETFs High-Probability Opening Bell Reversals Priced for $500+ Accounts Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Small account traders chase expensive, high-implied-volatility options contracts ($8.00 to $15.00 per contract) right as retail FOMO peaks at the open. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: Using the proprietary order-flow methodology passed down by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, we wait for institutional liquidity sweeps on liquid ETFs and stocks where clean, tight-spread options contracts cost a fraction of the price. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Tight structural invalidation levels just beyond the sweep high/low, keeping dollar risk small while targeting 200% to 300% asymmetric expansions.Playbook 02 // Defined-Risk Vertical Spreads Debit & Credit Spreads Capping Maximum Risk & Defeating Options Time Decay (Theta) Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Beginners buy cheap, far out-of-the-money weekly lottery-ticket calls or puts that have a 95% probability of expiring worthless due to rapid time decay. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: We teach small accounts how to pair a long option with a short option (vertical spreads), drastically lowering the cost of entry, neutralizing time decay, and supporting profitable execution even on moderate price moves. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Maximum possible loss is 100% locked in and known before entry, with zero margin surprises and zero Theta bleed traps.Playbook 03 // Contrarian Distribution Puts The +600% OXY Blueprint Turning Small Defined Risk Into Explosive Gains When Hype Collapses Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Retail traders with $500 accounts buy late into media hype, becoming exit liquidity for billionaires and institutional desks. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: This is the exact blueprint behind our famous Occidental Petroleum (OXY) trade: while Warren Buffett bought millions of dollars on the long side and retail chased the headline, we spotted institutional distribution and bought affordable OXY Put Options live for a 600% overnight gain. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Strictly defined premium risk on liquid put contracts when institutional volume confirms buyer exhaustion at major resistance.Playbook 04 // High-Velocity Small-Cap & ETF Swings Shares & Multi-Day Options Capturing 3-to-5 Day Compression Breakouts Without PDT Restrictions Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Traders in margin accounts under $25,000 get locked by the 3-day-trade Pattern Day Trader (PDT) rule or hold losing day trades overnight hoping to avoid a PDT strike. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: We provide pre-planned 2-to-5 day swing setups with exact entry triggers, profit targets, and hard stops that don’t count as day trades, allowing you to compound smoothly whether you use a cash account or a small margin account. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Pre-calculated share or contract sizing using our free Options Calculator so every trade respects your exact account balance. People Over Profits: Kept genuinely affordable so your hard-earned money stays inside your brokerage account."Small Account Challenge" Honesty Gambles 100% per trade across 10 hidden accounts, blows up 9 in secret, and markets the 1 lucky account on social media. 100% real, repeatable risk management taught by the trader Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick called "the future of trading."Contract Price Selection Calls out $12.00 ($1,200 per contract) options that a $500 to $1,500 account cannot even afford to buy. Hand-selected setups priced specifically for small-account affordability, tight bid-ask spreads, and high liquidity.PDT & T+1 Cash Account Rules Ignores Pattern Day Trader locks and cash settlement rules, leaving small accounts stranded with unsettled funds. Built-in daily buying-power allocation and T+1 cash rotation so you can trade consistently every market day.Pre-Trade Risk Definition Shouts "lotto calls" with zero stop-loss and tells members "only risk what you can afford to lose" when it goes to zero. Every setup specifies the exact entry trigger, tiered profit targets, and hard invalidation stop-loss ahead of time. People Over Profits • Start in the Right Room Discuss the Small Accounts Room Concept or Compare Our Other Trading Rooms & Alerts Our mission is to make sure every trader is placed in the exact environment built for their capital and daily routine: You Are Here // $500+ Capital Built for Small Accounts Small Accounts Room Engineered specifically for traders starting with $500 to $5,000. Get live guidance, affordable stock and options setups, T+1 cash account buying-power rotation, defined-risk vertical spreads, and strict stop-loss discipline. Discuss the Small Accounts Room Concept Working a 9-to-5 Job or Want Alerts Only? Swing Room & Sunday Alpha Protocol Interested in a different schedule? Explore our proposed Swing Trading Room or our ultra-affordable Sunday Alpha Protocol video watchlist alert tier for pre-planned multi-day entries, targets, and stops. Explore Video Watchlist Alerts Trading a Larger Intraday Account? Live Day Trading Room Already trading with larger capital and want our full-throttle intraday floor? Step into the Day Trading Room or SPX Profit Pulse for real-time voice, live screen sharing, and institutional order flow. Explore the Day Trading Room Direct Answers • Zero Hype Frequently Asked Questions About Growing a $500+ Small Account Is $500 really enough starting capital to join the Small Accounts Room? + A $500 figure is an illustrative account example, not a recommended starting balance or a statement that trading is suitable. Losses may consume the account. No membership is available.Should I use a Cash Account or a Margin Account if I have less than $25,000? + We teach you how to navigate both. In the United States, a Cash Account is exempt from the Pattern Day Trader (PDT) 3-day-trade limit. Because options and equities settle overnight on a T+1 schedule, your settled cash refreshes every single market morning. If you prefer a small margin account (or trade from Canada where PDT rules differ), we also execute multi-day swing setups and defined-risk spreads.Why do you care about $500 small accounts when you have Goldman Sachs mentorship pedigree? + The small-account concept concerns position sizing and risk awareness. Personal background claims are not evidence that the proposed program protects capital or produces profits.What if I work a full-time job and also have a small $500+ account? + The concept explores planning and risk education for different schedules and account sizes. It does not establish suitability or promise a manageable workload or return. No access is offered.What happens once my small account grows past $10,000 or $25,000? + Account growth and progression are not promised. Any roadmap is illustrative, and future programs, eligibility, and access have not been established. Educate • Innovate • Prosper We Are the Present and the Future. We Are the Revolution! Stop letting fake gurus convince you to gamble your hard-earned savings on repainted indicators and lottery tickets. Build and compound your $500+ account with real institutional risk discipline. 						All Day.
widths.mainText: Proposed concept, not an available service. The features, packages, schedules, platform support, charts, signals, and workflows below are development proposals or illustrative demonstrations. They are not live services, verified product capabilities, or an invitation to purchase or enroll. No price, release date, or future availability is guaranteed. When you step into the Revolution Trading Pros Swing Trading Room, you immediately know you finally found what you have been searching for: not hype, not fake "holy grail" repainted indicators, and not impulsive alerts you miss while at work, but pre-planned institutional swing execution built around your real life. I know what it feels like to be on the losing end of the market, because I stood there myself in the past. I know the frustration of working hard at your job, buying an overpriced course from an internet guru, and watching your swing trades get chopped to pieces because nobody taught you institutional accumulation, options time-decay control, or hard stop-losses. That is why we built this room with one uncompromising rule: we put people over profits. Directly mentored by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading giant Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who explicitly called me "the future of trading", I brought institutional order-flow discipline to self-directed traders: calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Bull Market Top and Bear Bottom, and executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade during high-volume institutional distribution for a reported 600% overnight gain (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results). Now, we hand you that exact multi-day institutional playbook in 15 to 20 minutes a day. "Educate, Innovate, and Prosper. You don't need six monitors or eight free hours a day to trade like a Goldman Sachs prop desk—you need pre-planned institutional structure, exact entries, and ironclad stops." Explore the Swing Trading Room Concept See the 20-Minute Working Pro Routine Ideal Trader Profile 9-to-5 Pros & Swing Traders Typical Hold Duration 2 Days to 3+ Weeks Daily Time Required 15–20 Mins Pre-Planned Risk Architecture Exact Entries, Targets & Stops 9-to-5 Execution Architecture How Every Swing Setup Is Delivered Set & Execute You never have to panic-buy a moving candle from a meeting room. Only want the video watchlist & alerts without the full room? See Sunday Alpha Protocol → Engineered for Busy Careers • Zero Screen Addiction The 20-Minute Working Professional Swing Trading Workflow You don’t lose to Wall Street because you have a full-time job. You lose when you try to day trade on a 5-minute break without a plan. Here is how our members trade institutional swings alongside demanding careers: Phase 01 // Sunday & Evening Macro Prep 20 Mins Evening Review Top-Down Macro Regime, Sector Rotation & Institutional Watchlist Before the trading week begins, and each evening after the market closes, we map where institutional capital is rotating across indexes, sector ETFs, and leading stocks so you never have to scramble at the 9:30 AM opening bell. Included in Your Room Membership: Macro breadth, volatility regime, and institutional accumulation/distribution read Focused multi-day watchlist of high-liquidity stocks, ETFs, and options structures Complete video and chart walkthroughs available on demand around your work and family schedulePhase 02 // Pre-Planned Order Structuring 10 Mins Pre-Market or Mobile Exact Trigger Entries, Tiered Profit Targets & Hard Stop-Losses Because you have a career or business to run, every swing setup is delivered well ahead of the trigger with exact price coordinates. You can input conditional orders on your phone or desktop in minutes and go back to your day. Included in Your Room Membership: Exact entry trigger zone instead of vague "watch this ticker" commentary Specific options contract structure (strike, expiration, delta, and debit/credit spread selection) Pre-calculated hard invalidation stop-loss and tiered profit-taking targets (Target 1, Target 2, Runner)Phase 03 // Multi-Day Position Management Real-Time Room & Alert Updates Scaling Out Into Strength, Trailing Stops & Overnight Risk Control Capturing 3-to-15-day institutional swings requires knowing when to lock in partial profits, when to raise stops to breakeven, and how to hedge overnight macro catalysts without getting shaken out by normal intraday noise. Included in Your Room Membership: Instant room updates whenever a swing setup triggers, hits Target 1, or adjusts its trailing stop Options time-decay (Theta) and implied volatility (Vega) protection rules for multi-day holds Portfolio-level exposure limits so you never over-concentrate in a single sectorPhase 04 // Interactive Desk Reviews & Q&A Live & Recorded Sessions Deep-Dive Chart Diagnostics, Open Position Audits & Member Q&A Unlike one-way alert newsletters that leave you guessing, the Swing Trading Room gives you direct access to our desk to review open positions, diagnose tickers on your personal radar, and master institutional swing mechanics. Included in Your Room Membership: Interactive chart reviews breaking down every open and closed swing trade Full archive of recorded sessions so working professionals in any time zone never miss a setup Direct education on why a setup worked, building your lifelong independence as a trader Goldman Sachs Mentored Methodology • Verified Market Calls Four Institutional Swing Playbooks Forged in Real Market Cycles Simple "buy the dip" retail swing trading gets crushed when volatility expands. Every trade in our Swing Trading Room is governed by one of four institutional playbooks: Playbook 01 // Multi-Week Institutional Accumulation Breakouts Hold: 3 to 15 Trading Days Compression-to-Expansion Breakouts Backed by Smart-Money Volume Why Retail Swing Traders Get Trapped: Retail swing traders buy late into extended 5-day rallies right as institutional algorithms begin distributing shares into retail FOMO. Our Institutional Execution Edge: Using the proprietary order-flow principles passed down by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, we identify multi-week institutional accumulation bases and enter as smart-money volume ignites out of compression. Risk, Stop-Loss & Options Structure: Hard stop placed below the institutional accumulation shelf, targeting a minimum 3:1 to 5:1 reward-to-risk expansion.Playbook 02 // Contrarian Distribution & Liquidity Exhaustion Swings Hold: 1 to 10 Trading Days The +600% OXY Put Options Playbook: Fading Retail Euphoria at Structural Tops Why Retail Swing Traders Get Trapped: When mainstream financial media celebrates a billionaire headline or earnings hype, retail traders pile in on the long side at the exact top of a liquidity sweep. Our Institutional Execution Edge: This is the exact methodology we used when Warren Buffett went long millions of dollars in Occidental Petroleum (OXY) and we shorted live with OXY Put Options for a 600% overnight gain. We spot institutional distribution hiding behind bullish headlines. Risk, Stop-Loss & Options Structure: Defined-risk put options or put debit spreads with capped downside and explosive asymmetric payoff during multi-day unwinds.Playbook 03 // Macro Inflection & Sector Rotation Swings Hold: 1 to 4 Weeks Riding Major Regime Shifts Using Our 2020 & 2022 Cycle Framework Why Retail Swing Traders Get Trapped: Most swing services use static bull-market rules that get obliterated when the macro regime flips from accumulation to bear distribution. Our Institutional Execution Edge: Anchored in the exact macro timing framework that called the 2020 COVID top and bottom and the 2022 bull market top and bear market bottom, we rotate capital into leading sectors or pivot to index/sector puts when macro breadth breaks. Risk, Stop-Loss & Options Structure: Top-down sector relative strength filtering combined with trailing structural stops behind daily and weekly higher lows.Playbook 04 // Asymmetric Options Spreads & Time-Decay Control Hold: 3 to 21 Trading Days Structuring Calls, Puts, Verticals & Diagonals That Survive Overnight Noise Why Retail Swing Traders Get Trapped: Amateurs buy short-dated, far out-of-the-money weekly options for swing trades and lose money to Theta decay even when the stock moves in their direction. Our Institutional Execution Edge: We structure swing options positions with institutional precision, selecting the right expiration window, delta profile, or vertical/diagonal spread so time decay and implied volatility work in your favor. Risk, Stop-Loss & Options Structure: 100% defined capital at risk per trade, with your maximum dollar risk known before you ever submit the order. People Over Profits: Accessible membership focused entirely on member growth and consistency.Institutional Lineage Part-time social media marketers with zero Wall Street training or verified macro calls. Mentored by former Goldman Sachs prop legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick ("the future of trading").9-to-5 Schedule Compatibility Sends impulsive mid-day alerts that are already up 40% by the time you check your phone. Pre-planned setups with exact entry zones, targets, and stops you can set in 15–20 minutes a day.Options Structuring Reckless out-of-the-money lottery tickets that decay to zero over a 3-day hold. Institutional expiration, delta, and spread structuring built to hold cleanly across multi-day moves.Proven Track Record Cherry-picked hindsight screenshots with losing trades quietly deleted. Called the 2020 & 2022 market tops and bottoms and banked +600% overnight on OXY Put Options live. People Over Profits • Choose Your Exact Fit Discuss the Swing Trading Room Concept or Select the Tier Built for Your Capital & Schedule We never push you into the wrong tier just to collect a fee. Compare our three multi-day and account-specific pathways below so you start in the exact right place: You Are Here // Full Room Experience Best for Working Professionals Swing Trading Room The complete interactive swing trading desk: evening and weekly video chart reviews, pre-planned stock, ETF, and options swing setups with exact entries, targets, and stops, portfolio rotation workshops, and direct Q&A with our team. Discuss the Swing Trading Room Concept Want Alert-Only Video Watchlists? Sunday Alpha Protocol (Alert Service) Prefer an ultra-affordable alert-only membership without full room sessions? Sunday Alpha Protocol sends you our detailed video watchlists and trade alerts complete with exact targeted entries, profit exits, and stop-loss levels. Explore Sunday Alpha Protocol Starting With a $500+ Account? Small Accounts Room ($500+ Capital) Growing an account starting as low as $500? Our dedicated Small Accounts Room teaches strict small-account risk management, affordable options and stock selection, and safe capital compounding. Explore Small Accounts Room Direct Transparency • Zero Fluff Frequently Asked Questions About the Swing Trading Room How much time per day do I need to follow the Swing Trading Room if I have a full-time job? + The proposed workflow explores preparation outside market hours. Time requirements depend on the activity and are not established or guaranteed. No live service or enrollment is available.Do you swing trade shares of stock, ETFs, or options contracts? + Stocks, ETFs, and options are the proposed educational scope. They involve different risks and may be unsuitable for a particular reader. This is not an available trading or advisory service.How is the Swing Trading Room different from your Sunday Alpha Protocol alert service? + The swing room concept explores discussion and chart review; Sunday Alpha explores prepared educational scenarios. Both are in development and neither offers current paid access or subscriptions.How did your methodology call the 2020 and 2022 tops/bottoms and the +600% OXY trade? + Historical timing and return claims require original supporting records and context. They do not verify the effectiveness of this concept or predict future results.Can I pair the Swing Trading Room with your custom non-repainting indicators and courses? + The store, courses, indicators, scanners, and mentorship are proposed concepts. No purchases, software delivery, applications, or paid enrollment are currently available. Educate • Innovate • Prosper Wall Street Protects Its Own. Private 1-on-1 Stock & Options Trading Mentorship for
						Portfolio Managers, Pro Traders & Struggling Traders You Cannot Buy Your Way Into This Room. You Have to Be Approved.
widths.mainText: Proposed concept, not an available service. The features, packages, schedules, platform support, charts, signals, and workflows below are development proposals or illustrative demonstrations. They are not live services, verified product capabilities, or an invitation to purchase or enroll. No price, release date, or future availability is guaranteed. Home 1-on-1 Mentorship Concept Status: Applications and enrollment are unavailable Strictly By Application & Approval Only Goldman Sachs Prop Lineage • People Over Profits Private 1-on-1 Stock & Options Trading Mentorship for Portfolio Managers, Pro Traders & Struggling Traders You Cannot Buy Your Way Into This Room. You Have to Be Approved. If our goal were making quick money off subscriptions, there would be a "Buy Now" checkout button on this page. There isn’t one, because at Revolution Trading Pros, we care about people, not collecting fees. Whether you are a Portfolio Manager seeking macro inflection timing and asymmetric options hedging, a Full-Time Professional Trader fighting to break through a six- or seven-figure PnL plateau, or a Struggling Trader exhausted from losing money to fake "holy grail" indicators, I know exactly where you stand. I have stood on the losing end myself in the past before being mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called me "the future of trading." That direct 1-on-1 mentorship instilled institutional order-flow discipline: calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, and executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade during high-volume institutional distribution for a reported 600% overnight gain (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results). Now, we open a strictly limited number of private 1-on-1 seats each quarter to pass that exact institutional edge directly to you. "Mark 'Goldfinger' McGoldrick passed down the Goldman Sachs proprietary playbook through direct 1-on-1 mentorship. Educate, Innovate, and Prosper—we are the present and the future, we are the revolution!" Submit Your 1-on-1 Application Compare the 3 Candidate Tracks Admissions Committee Dossier 1-on-1 Mentorship Vetting Protocol No Checkout Button 01 // Who This Is Engineered For Portfolio Managers (Macro & Options Hedging), Professional Traders (Scaling & Order Flow), and Struggling Traders (Complete Mechanical Turnaround). 02 // Institutional Lineage Direct proprietary trading methodology passed down by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick. 03 // Verified Execution Proof 2020 COVID Top/Bottom • 2022 Bull Top/Bear Bottom • +600% Overnight on OXY Put Options live vs. Warren Buffett. 04 // Why Approval Is Mandatory 1-on-1 mentorship requires intense personal time from our desk. We reject anyone looking for a lazy "magic indicator" shortcut and accept only 100% coachable candidates. 4-Step Admissions Sequence: Step 1: Select Your Candidate Track Below Step 2: Submit Your Written Application Dossier Step 3: Desk Review & Diagnostic Audit Step 4: Final Approval & 1-on-1 Onboarding Proceed to Application Dossier Three Distinct Tracks • Customized 1-on-1 Execution Built for Portfolio Managers, Professional Traders, and Struggling Traders Ready to Turn the Corner A group webinar forces everyone into the same box. Because our mentorship is strictly 1-on-1, your curriculum, risk architecture, and live drills are custom-engineered around one of three dedicated tracks: Track 01 // Institutional & Capital Allocators Portfolio Managers & Family Offices Portfolio Managers & Desk Leads Macro Regime Timing, Asymmetric Options Overlays & Drawdown Protection The Bottleneck Holding You Back: Conventional buy-and-hold models and lagging street research leave portfolios exposed at major macro inflection points, suffering severe drawdowns during liquidity cascades like 2020 and 2022 while missing asymmetric contrarian opportunities. Our 1-on-1 Institutional Intervention: We install the exact proprietary macro cycle and order-flow framework passed down by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, the same methodology that called the 2020 COVID top and bottom, the 2022 bull top and bear bottom, and our 600% overnight OXY Put Options trade against Warren Buffett’s long position. Core 1-on-1 Deliverables: Macro Regime & Liquidity Inflection Framework: Identify institutional distribution tops and capitulation bottoms before consensus research reacts. Asymmetric Options Hedging & Alpha Overlays: Structure defined-risk put spreads, collars, and volatility skew trades to monetize downside cascades. Execution & Liquidity Sweep Telemetry: Enter and exit large equity, ETF, and index options positions using institutional absorption zones. Direct 1-on-1 Desk Consultation: Private weekly strategy reviews tailored to your mandate, risk tolerance, and capital allocation rules. Preview the Portfolio Manager Track Track 02 // Full-Time & Prop Execution Professional & Active Traders Professional Traders Breaking PnL Plateaus, Scaling Size & Mastering Institutional Order Flow The Bottleneck Holding You Back: You already know how to read charts and generate winning weeks, but you hit an invisible ceiling when scaling contract or share size, giving back weeks of gains on low-quality chop days or hesitating on A+ institutional setups. Our 1-on-1 Institutional Intervention: We perform a forensic audit of your trade ledger, strip out low-expectancy setups, and upgrade your execution with zero-repaint institutional telemetry, options volatility structuring, and Goldman Sachs prop-desk sizing mathematics. Core 1-on-1 Deliverables: Forensic Trade Ledger & Expectancy Audit: Pinpoint the exact time-of-day, instrument, and behavioral leaks capping your equity curve. Institutional Order Flow & Trap Recognition: Spot where retail breakout traders are trapped and execute alongside smart-money liquidity sweeps. Conviction Sizing & Scaling Architecture: Mathematical rules for pressing A+ setups with size while keeping B-grade chop exposure near zero. Live Market Co-Execution Drills: Real-time 1-on-1 feedback on entries, tiered profit scaling, and dynamic stop management. Preview the Professional Trader Track Track 03 // Complete Retail Turnaround Struggling Traders Seeking Rescue Struggling Traders Stop the Bleeding, Unlearn Fake Guru Lies & Rebuild With Mechanical Discipline The Bottleneck Holding You Back: You have bought overpriced courses and fake "holy grail" repainted indicators, jumped from strategy to strategy, and watched your hard-earned account bleed out through FOMO, hesitation, and undefined risk. Our 1-on-1 Institutional Intervention: Because our founder stood on the losing end in the past before being mentored by Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, we know exactly how to pull you out of the retail trap. We strip away every fake indicator, rebuild your foundation from zero, and give you a mechanical checklist with exact entries, exits, and hard stops. Core 1-on-1 Deliverables: Total Retail Detox & Account Stabilization: Immediately halt account bleed by eliminating repainted indicators and impulse trades. Mechanical Pre-Trade Checklist Installation: Never enter a stock or option trade without a predefined trigger price, profit target, and hard stop-loss. Right-Sized Capital Compounding ($500+ to Six Figures): Position-sizing rules built for your exact current account balance and 9-to-5 schedule. 1-on-1 Psychological & Execution Accountability: Direct mentorship to eradicate revenge trading, fear of pulling the trigger, and early profit-taking. Preview the Struggling Trader Track Earned In Live Market Combat Why Portfolio Managers Respect Our Edge and Why Struggling Traders Finally Feel Safe Here Very few traders in the world have lived on both sides of the market divide. Early on, I experienced the exact retail heartbreak that struggling traders face every day: being lied to by marketers selling repainted "holy grail" indicators and watching hard-earned capital vanish. Then I was mentored by former Goldman Sachs proprietary trading giant Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick. He didn't teach me how to sell courses; he taught me how Wall Street balance sheets hunt retail stops, how institutional liquidity dries up at macro tops, and how to deploy options with ruthless mathematical asymmetry. When you sit across from us in 1-on-1 Mentorship, you get a mentor who possesses the institutional firepower to advise Portfolio Managers and Professional Traders on macro cycle turns, combined with the genuine human empathy to take a struggling trader by the hand and rebuild their confidence and execution brick by brick. Proof 01 // Wall Street Pedigree Goldman Sachs Lineage Mentored by Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick Trained directly by one of the highest-earning proprietary traders in Goldman Sachs history, who explicitly called our founder "the future of trading." Proof 02 // Contrarian Options Execution +600% Overnight on OXY Shorted OXY Live vs. Warren Buffett’s Long While Warren Buffett bought millions in Occidental Petroleum (OXY) and retail chased the headline, we spotted institutional distribution and banked 600% overnight on OXY Put Options live. Proof 03 // 2020 Macro Cycle Call 2020 Top & Bottom Called the COVID Crash & Generational Low Warned traders of structural breakdown before the February 2020 crash cascaded, then pivoted at the exact March 2020 capitulation bottom. Proof 04 // 2022 Macro Cycle Call 2022 Top & Bottom Called the 2022 Bull Top & Bear Bottom Repeated the feat in the very next cycle, calling the January 2022 distribution top and the October 2022 institutional accumulation bottom. Educate • Innovate • Prosper Inside the Four-Phase 1‑on‑1 Transformation Architecture Once your application is approved, we do not hand you a login to pre-recorded fluff and disappear. Every accepted mentee progresses through a structured, four-phase institutional rebuild: Phase 01 Diagnostic & Detox Forensic Execution Autopsy & Eliminating the Bleed Before adding a single new setup, we audit your historical trades, portfolio structure, and chart layout. We ruthlessly strip out lagging retail oscillators, repainted "holy grail" scripts, and destructive sizing habits. Verified Phase Benchmarks: Complete diagnostic breakdown of your past 90 days of execution or portfolio allocation Immediate removal of low-probability setups and emotional triggers Custom risk-per-trade and daily/weekly drawdown circuit breakersPhase 02 Institutional Foundation Installing the Goldman Sachs Prop-Desk Market Framework You learn to read the market the way former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick taught our founder: tracking institutional accumulation, distribution, liquidity sweeps, and abandoned price bars across stocks, ETFs, and indexes. Verified Phase Benchmarks: Mastery of institutional supply/demand zones and smart-money liquidity traps Top-down macro cycle and sector rotation alignment (the 2020 & 2022 inflection playbook) Integration of our 100% non-repainting custom indicators and live scannersPhase 03 Precision Structuring Asymmetric Options & Equity Trade Structuring (Entries, Targets & Stops) Great market direction still loses money if you buy the wrong option contract or set stops in retail liquidity pools. We train you to structure asymmetric reward-to-risk trades with mathematical precision. Verified Phase Benchmarks: Exact contract, strike, expiration, and implied volatility selection (single-leg, spreads, diagonals, hedges) Mechanical mapping of targeted entries, tiered profit-taking exits, and hard invalidation stops Case-study deconstruction of our live +600% overnight OXY Put Options execution vs. Warren BuffettPhase 04 Live Mastery & Scale 1‑on‑1 Live Market Calibration & Independent Execution Our goal is never to make you dependent on us forever; it is to make you a self-sufficient, fearless institutional executor. We review your live trades one-on-one until your discipline is automatic. Verified Phase Benchmarks: Private 1-on-1 trade review sessions grading your adherence to your custom playbook Structured capital scaling roadmap as your win rate and profit factor stabilize Full access to our live trading rooms and video watchlists to reinforce daily preparation Proposed Criteria • Applications Closed Proposed Mentorship Suitability Criteria We protect the integrity of our desk and our mentees’ results. Before filling out the application dossier below, verify where you stand: Automatic Disqualification Who We Reject "Holy Grail" Shortcut Seekers: Anyone looking for a magic repainting arrow indicator so they never have to learn price structure or risk management. Uncoachable Egos: Traders who refuse to journal their trades, ignore hard stop-loss levels, or blame the market instead of taking ownership. Lottery-Ticket Gamblers: Applicants looking to bet 100% of their rent money on a single 0DTE option trade overnight without risk controls. Zero Time Commitment: Anyone unwilling to show up prepared for their scheduled 1-on-1 trade reviews and execution drills. Ideal Mentorship Candidates Who We Approve Portfolio Managers & Desk Leads: Seeking institutional macro inflection timing, liquidity-sweep telemetry, and asymmetric options hedging overlays. Full-Time & Developing Pro Traders: Ready to audit their execution leaks, scale contract/share sizing mathematically, and master order flow. Coachable Struggling Traders: Honest about past losses, ready to throw away fake guru habits, and committed to following a mechanical entry/exit/stop checklist. Long-Term Builders ($500+ to $10M+): Regardless of starting capital, traders who treat this as an elite profession and put in the work. Concept only · applications and paid enrollment unavailable. Do not enter personal or financial information. 01 // Select Your Candidate Track (Required) Track 01 Portfolio Manager / Allocator Macro cycle timing, options hedging & institutional execution Track 02 Professional / Active Trader Breaking PnL plateaus, scaling size & order-flow mastery Track 03 Struggling Trader Turnaround Stop the bleeding, unlearn fake guru habits & rebuild mechanically 02 // Candidate Identification & Jurisdiction Full Legal Name * Primary Email Address * Direct Phone Number (For Admissions Call) * Country / Market Jurisdiction * United StatesCanadaUnited Kingdom / EuropeOther International 03 // Capital Mandate, Markets Traded & Diagnostic Audit Current Trading Capital or AUM Tier * $500 – $5,000 (Small Account Turnaround)$5,000 – $25,000 (Developing Trader)$25,000 – $100,000 (Active / Full-Time)$100,000 – $1,000,000 (Professional Desk)$1,000,000+ (Portfolio Manager / Institutional / Family Office) Primary Trading Schedule & Availability * Full-Time Market Hours (9:30 AM – 4:00 PM ET)Portfolio Manager / Institutional MandateWorking Professional (9-to-5 / Swing & Pre-Planned Execution)Opening Bell Only (First 60–90 Minutes) Be Brutally Honest: What Is Your #1 Trading Bottleneck, Goal, or Reason for Applying Right Now? * Mandatory Candidate Pledge: I understand that Revolution Trading Pros 1-on-1 Mentorship is strictly by application and approval only. If accepted, I commit to being 100% coachable, abandoning fake "holy grail" indicator shortcuts, and following strict institutional risk and stop-loss rules. Applications Are Not Available Development preview only. This form is disabled and does not submit an application. Direct Answers • Zero Evasion Frequently Asked Questions About 1-on-1 Mentorship Admissions Why can't I just pay and join 1-on-1 Mentorship immediately? + A future program might use an application and fit review.
