widths.mainText: Home Our Mission Educate • Innovate • Prosper • People Over Profits The Anti-Guru Charter Why We Focus on People Over Profits Our Mission: Honest Stock & Options Trading Education, Live Execution & Member Success Our Goal Is to Help You Build Your Dreams, Not Drain Your Capital. Most trading education services are built with a single, predatory goal: extract as much money from you as possible by selling overpriced courses and fake "holy grail" indicators. Revolution Trading Pros was built to burn that model to the ground. Because I have stood on the losing end of the market in the past, I know the sickening feeling of trusting a "guru" only to realize their indicators repaint and their trade calls are hindsight lies. When former Wall Street Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick mentored me directly and called me "the future of trading," I made a vow: I would bring real Wall Street execution to everyday people at a price anyone can afford. Whether we are calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, or executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade for a reported 600% overnight gain into institutional distribution (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results), our mission never changes: Educate, Innovate, and Prosper. We put people over profits. "We are the present and the future—we are the revolution! When you step inside our rooms, you finally know you found what you have been searching for." Concept only · purchases, paid subscriptions, and enrollment are unavailable. Founder background statements are personal accounts, not independent verification or a Goldman Sachs endorsement. Explore Our Live Trading Rooms See Video Watchlist & Alert Tiers Official Ethical Standard The "People Over Profits" Charter Non-Negotiable 01 Zero Fake "Holy Grail" Indicators We never build, sell, or promote repainted scripts or fake "100% win-rate" arrows. 02 Zero Overpriced Guru Courses We keep our rooms, alerts, and store items accessible so your money stays in your trading account. 03 Exact Entries, Exits & Stops Ahead of Time No hindsight cherry-picking. Every live call and video watchlist defines risk before price moves. 04 Built for $500+ Small Accounts & Working Pros Dedicated rooms and video alerts so busy 9-to-5 professionals and $500 starter accounts thrive. 05 1-on-1 Mentorship by Approval Only You cannot buy your way into 1-on-1 coaching. We vet and approve every candidate by hand. Read the Founder’s Reported Background Exposing the Industry Lie • Hard Evidence Why 95% of Trading Education Services Want You to Stay Dependent and Why We Refuse To understand our mission, you have to confront the ugly truth about how most online trading educators in the United States and Canada actually make their money. Industry Trap #1 Exposed The $2,500 "Holy Grail" Indicator Scam Marketers code lagging oscillators that rewrite their signals after the candle closes, slap a "94% Accuracy" label on a sales page, and charge desperate traders thousands of dollars. When you load that indicator in a live market, it whipsaws your account to zero. Our Solution: Every custom indicator and institutional scanner we engineer is 100% non-repainting, built to expose real institutional order flow, abandoned price bars, and liquidity sweeps at a fair price. Industry Trap #2 Exposed Vague Alerts With No Stops or Risk Parameters Most alert rooms shout out 20 tickers at the open with zero entry triggers and zero stop-loss levels. If 18 fail and 2 go up, the guru brags about the 2 winners all week while members silently bleed out on the 18 losers. Our Solution: In our live rooms and our affordable alert-only tiers (Sunday Alpha Protocol & SPX Profit Pulse), we deliver detailed video watchlists with exact targeted entries, profit exits, and hard invalidation stops ahead of time. Industry Trap #3 Exposed Pricing Out $500 Accounts & Working Families Traditional trading rooms cater exclusively to wealthy day traders who can sit at six monitors all day and absorb $2,000 drawdowns, leaving working parents and $500 starter accounts to blow up trying to copy oversized trades. Our Solution: We built the Small Accounts Room specifically for accounts starting as low as $500, and the Swing Trading Room for working professionals who need multi-day precision. Our Core Slogan in Action Educate. Innovate. Prosper. How Our Three Pillars Transform Traders "Educate, Innovate, and Prosper" isn't a marketing catchphrase; it is the exact three-stage engineering blueprint behind every room, alert service, and tool at Revolution Trading Pros. Pillar 01 // Truth Over Textbook Theory Educate. Teach Real Institutional Market Mechanics Without Recycled Retail Hype Retail traders lose because they are taught lagging retail patterns that institutional algorithms actively hunt. We educate our members using the exact order flow, liquidity exhaustion, and asymmetric risk principles passed down from former Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick. The Member Outcome: From $500 starter accounts to full-time professionals, every member learns why a trade works before risking a single dollar. Direct Ecosystem Pathways: Structured Trading Courses Small Accounts Room ($500+) Market Intelligence Blogs Pillar 02 // Zero-Repaint Precision Telemetry Innovate. Build Honest, Non-Repainting Indicators, Scanners & Free Public Tools The trading industry is flooded with $2,000 "holy grail" indicators engineered to repaint arrows after the candle closes so marketers can film fake promotional videos. We innovate by building 100% non-repainting custom indicators, live institutional scanners, and free public calculators that print objective truth in real time. The Member Outcome: Every signal, liquidity zone, and abandoned price bar prints live and stays on the chart permanently, giving you verifiable clarity. Direct Ecosystem Pathways: Custom Non-Repainting Indicators Institutional Market Scanners Free Options Calculator Pillar 03 // People Over Profits Prosper. Deliver Affordable Live Execution & Exact Video Watchlists So Members Thrive Education and tools mean nothing if subscription fees drain your trading capital. We keep our live trading rooms and alert services genuinely affordable, delivering real-time intraday execution and detailed video watchlists with exact targeted entries, profit exits, and hard stop-losses. The Member Outcome: Whether you trade live with us at the opening bell or execute swings around a 9-to-5 career, our only metric of success is your consistency. Direct Ecosystem Pathways: Live Day Trading Room Swing Trading Room Sunday Alpha Protocol Video Watchlist Accountability Written in Stone Six Ironclad Promises We Make to Every Trader Who Walks Through Our Doors The proposed Revolution Trading Pros concept is intended to support an institution governed by six unbreakable commitments to your success. Commitment #01 Ethical Pricing Standard Radical Affordability: Keep Your Capital in Your Brokerage Account What Broken Services Do: Fake gurus charge $3,000 to $10,000 for basic courses, stripping new traders of the very capital they need to trade. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: We price our Live Trading Rooms, Alert Services (SPX Profit Pulse & Sunday Alpha Protocol), Courses, Indicators, and Scanners for maximum accessibility because we make our living from the market, not from gouging students.Commitment #02 Zero Repainting Law No Fake "Holy Grail" Indicators. Ever. What Broken Services Do: Predatory indicator sellers market scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight and leave traders trapped in live market chop. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: We will never sell you a "magic buy/sell arrow" fantasy. Every custom indicator and scanner in our Store is 100% non-repainting and built on real institutional volume, price structure, and liquidity exhaustion.Commitment #03 Pre-Trade Accountability Exact Entries, Profit Targets & Hard Stops Before the Move Happens What Broken Services Do: Internet marketers post winning screenshots after the market closes without ever defining risk ahead of time. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: Every setup called in our rooms or delivered in our video watchlists defines the exact entry trigger, tiered profit targets, and hard invalidation stop-loss before execution, the same standard behind our 2020, 2022, and +600% OXY Put Options calls.Commitment #04 Complete Inclusivity No Trader Left Behind: From $500 Small Accounts to Working Pros What Broken Services Do: Most trading rooms force a single reckless style that blows up $500 accounts and excludes people with full-time 9-to-5 jobs. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: We maintain dedicated environments for every reality: the Small Accounts Room for $500+ capital, the Swing Trading Room and Sunday Alpha Protocol alerts for working professionals, and the Day Trading Room and SPX Profit Pulse for intraday traders.Commitment #05 Merit Over Money 1-on-1 Mentorship by Application and Approval Only What Broken Services Do: Traditional coaching programs accept anyone whose credit card clears, regardless of whether the student is ready. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: You cannot buy your way into our 1-on-1 Mentorship off the shelf. Every applicant is manually reviewed and approved based on coachability, discipline, and work ethic, proving we care about transformation over revenue.Commitment #06 Earned Authority Battle-Tested Wall Street Lineage & Live Market Proof What Broken Services Do: Unqualified educators teach theory they have never executed against institutional order flow. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: Every lesson we teach is anchored in lived market combat, forged by standing on the losing side first, being mentored by Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, and executing live through the 2020 and 2022 macro turns. widths.title: Our Mission: People Over Profits | Revolution Trading Pros
h1:
Our Mission: Honest Stock & Options Trading Education, Live Execution & Member
						Success Our Goal Is to Help You Build Your Dreams, Not Drain Your Capital.
widths.mainText: Home Our Mission Educate • Innovate • Prosper • People Over Profits The Anti-Guru Charter Why We Focus on People Over Profits Our Mission: Honest Stock & Options Trading Education, Live Execution & Member Success Our Goal Is to Help You Build Your Dreams, Not Drain Your Capital. Most trading education services are built with a single, predatory goal: extract as much money from you as possible by selling overpriced courses and fake "holy grail" indicators. Revolution Trading Pros was built to burn that model to the ground. Because I have stood on the losing end of the market in the past, I know the sickening feeling of trusting a "guru" only to realize their indicators repaint and their trade calls are hindsight lies. When former Wall Street Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick mentored me directly and called me "the future of trading," I made a vow: I would bring real Wall Street execution to everyday people at a price anyone can afford. Whether we are calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, or executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade for a reported 600% overnight gain into institutional distribution (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results), our mission never changes: Educate, Innovate, and Prosper. We put people over profits. "We are the present and the future—we are the revolution! When you step inside our rooms, you finally know you found what you have been searching for." Concept only · purchases, paid subscriptions, and enrollment are unavailable. Founder background statements are personal accounts, not independent verification or a Goldman Sachs endorsement. Explore Our Live Trading Rooms See Video Watchlist & Alert Tiers Official Ethical Standard The "People Over Profits" Charter Non-Negotiable 01 Zero Fake "Holy Grail" Indicators We never build, sell, or promote repainted scripts or fake "100% win-rate" arrows. 02 Zero Overpriced Guru Courses We keep our rooms, alerts, and store items accessible so your money stays in your trading account. 03 Exact Entries, Exits & Stops Ahead of Time No hindsight cherry-picking. Every live call and video watchlist defines risk before price moves. 04 Built for $500+ Small Accounts & Working Pros Dedicated rooms and video alerts so busy 9-to-5 professionals and $500 starter accounts thrive. 05 1-on-1 Mentorship by Approval Only You cannot buy your way into 1-on-1 coaching. We vet and approve every candidate by hand. Read the Founder’s Reported Background Exposing the Industry Lie • Hard Evidence Why 95% of Trading Education Services Want You to Stay Dependent and Why We Refuse To understand our mission, you have to confront the ugly truth about how most online trading educators in the United States and Canada actually make their money. Industry Trap #1 Exposed The $2,500 "Holy Grail" Indicator Scam Marketers code lagging oscillators that rewrite their signals after the candle closes, slap a "94% Accuracy" label on a sales page, and charge desperate traders thousands of dollars. When you load that indicator in a live market, it whipsaws your account to zero. Our Solution: Every custom indicator and institutional scanner we engineer is 100% non-repainting, built to expose real institutional order flow, abandoned price bars, and liquidity sweeps at a fair price. Industry Trap #2 Exposed Vague Alerts With No Stops or Risk Parameters Most alert rooms shout out 20 tickers at the open with zero entry triggers and zero stop-loss levels. If 18 fail and 2 go up, the guru brags about the 2 winners all week while members silently bleed out on the 18 losers. Our Solution: In our live rooms and our affordable alert-only tiers (Sunday Alpha Protocol & SPX Profit Pulse), we deliver detailed video watchlists with exact targeted entries, profit exits, and hard invalidation stops ahead of time. Industry Trap #3 Exposed Pricing Out $500 Accounts & Working Families Traditional trading rooms cater exclusively to wealthy day traders who can sit at six monitors all day and absorb $2,000 drawdowns, leaving working parents and $500 starter accounts to blow up trying to copy oversized trades. Our Solution: We built the Small Accounts Room specifically for accounts starting as low as $500, and the Swing Trading Room for working professionals who need multi-day precision. Our Core Slogan in Action Educate. Innovate. Prosper. How Our Three Pillars Transform Traders "Educate, Innovate, and Prosper" isn't a marketing catchphrase; it is the exact three-stage engineering blueprint behind every room, alert service, and tool at Revolution Trading Pros. Pillar 01 // Truth Over Textbook Theory Educate. Teach Real Institutional Market Mechanics Without Recycled Retail Hype Retail traders lose because they are taught lagging retail patterns that institutional algorithms actively hunt. We educate our members using the exact order flow, liquidity exhaustion, and asymmetric risk principles passed down from former Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick. The Member Outcome: From $500 starter accounts to full-time professionals, every member learns why a trade works before risking a single dollar. Direct Ecosystem Pathways: Structured Trading Courses Small Accounts Room ($500+) Market Intelligence Blogs Pillar 02 // Zero-Repaint Precision Telemetry Innovate. Build Honest, Non-Repainting Indicators, Scanners & Free Public Tools The trading industry is flooded with $2,000 "holy grail" indicators engineered to repaint arrows after the candle closes so marketers can film fake promotional videos. We innovate by building 100% non-repainting custom indicators, live institutional scanners, and free public calculators that print objective truth in real time. The Member Outcome: Every signal, liquidity zone, and abandoned price bar prints live and stays on the chart permanently, giving you verifiable clarity. Direct Ecosystem Pathways: Custom Non-Repainting Indicators Institutional Market Scanners Free Options Calculator Pillar 03 // People Over Profits Prosper. Deliver Affordable Live Execution & Exact Video Watchlists So Members Thrive Education and tools mean nothing if subscription fees drain your trading capital. We keep our live trading rooms and alert services genuinely affordable, delivering real-time intraday execution and detailed video watchlists with exact targeted entries, profit exits, and hard stop-losses. The Member Outcome: Whether you trade live with us at the opening bell or execute swings around a 9-to-5 career, our only metric of success is your consistency. Direct Ecosystem Pathways: Live Day Trading Room Swing Trading Room Sunday Alpha Protocol Video Watchlist Accountability Written in Stone Six Ironclad Promises We Make to Every Trader Who Walks Through Our Doors The proposed Revolution Trading Pros concept is intended to support an institution governed by six unbreakable commitments to your success. Commitment #01 Ethical Pricing Standard Radical Affordability: Keep Your Capital in Your Brokerage Account What Broken Services Do: Fake gurus charge $3,000 to $10,000 for basic courses, stripping new traders of the very capital they need to trade. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: We price our Live Trading Rooms, Alert Services (SPX Profit Pulse & Sunday Alpha Protocol), Courses, Indicators, and Scanners for maximum accessibility because we make our living from the market, not from gouging students.Commitment #02 Zero Repainting Law No Fake "Holy Grail" Indicators. Ever. What Broken Services Do: Predatory indicator sellers market scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight and leave traders trapped in live market chop. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: We will never sell you a "magic buy/sell arrow" fantasy. Every custom indicator and scanner in our Store is 100% non-repainting and built on real institutional volume, price structure, and liquidity exhaustion.Commitment #03 Pre-Trade Accountability Exact Entries, Profit Targets & Hard Stops Before the Move Happens What Broken Services Do: Internet marketers post winning screenshots after the market closes without ever defining risk ahead of time. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: Every setup called in our rooms or delivered in our video watchlists defines the exact entry trigger, tiered profit targets, and hard invalidation stop-loss before execution, the same standard behind our 2020, 2022, and +600% OXY Put Options calls.Commitment #04 Complete Inclusivity No Trader Left Behind: From $500 Small Accounts to Working Pros What Broken Services Do: Most trading rooms force a single reckless style that blows up $500 accounts and excludes people with full-time 9-to-5 jobs. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: We maintain dedicated environments for every reality: the Small Accounts Room for $500+ capital, the Swing Trading Room and Sunday Alpha Protocol alerts for working professionals, and the Day Trading Room and SPX Profit Pulse for intraday traders.Commitment #05 Merit Over Money 1-on-1 Mentorship by Application and Approval Only What Broken Services Do: Traditional coaching programs accept anyone whose credit card clears, regardless of whether the student is ready. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: You cannot buy your way into our 1-on-1 Mentorship off the shelf. Every applicant is manually reviewed and approved based on coachability, discipline, and work ethic, proving we care about transformation over revenue.Commitment #06 Earned Authority Battle-Tested Wall Street Lineage & Live Market Proof What Broken Services Do: Unqualified educators teach theory they have never executed against institutional order flow. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: Every lesson we teach is anchored in lived market combat, forged by standing on the losing side first, being mentored by Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, and executing live through the 2020 and 2022 macro turns. Find Your Exact Starting Point Built Around Your Real Life, Your Schedule, and Your Starting Capital Because we focus on people rather than maximizing fees, we structured our ecosystem so every trader, from a $500 beginner or a busy working parent to a full-time options scalper, has a dedicated home. 9-to-5 Careers & Busy Schedules Working Professionals The Struggle You Know Too Well: You work hard at your career and cannot sit glued to 1-minute charts for six hours a day, yet you refuse to settle for 7% index returns while inflation erodes your future. How Our Mission Covers You: Our Swing Trading Room and Sunday Alpha Protocol video watchlists hand you institutional multi-day stock and options setups with pre-planned entries, exits, and stops you can execute in 15 minutes. Explore Swing Trading Room View Sunday Alpha Protocol Starting Capital as Low as $500 $500+ Small Account Traders The Struggle You Know Too Well: You have $500 to $2,500 to start, and you are tired of rooms calling $15.00 options contracts where one normal pullback wipes out half your account. How Our Mission Covers You: Our Small Accounts Room is built specifically for $500+ accounts, teaching strict position sizing, cash-account T+1 rotation, and high-probability setups priced for small-account survival and compounding. Explore Small Accounts Room Try Free Options Calculator Intraday Velocity & Scalping Day Traders, Scalpers & Full-Time Pros The Struggle You Know Too Well: You are tired of delayed chatroom text messages and hesitant moderators who only talk after the candle has already broken out. How Our Mission Covers You: Our Day Trading Room and SPX Profit Pulse alerts deliver live pre-market game plans, real-time voice execution, live screen sharing, and institutional order-flow reads on stocks, ETFs, and SPX options. Explore Day Trading Room View SPX Profit Pulse Serious Career Transformation 1-on-1 Mentorship Candidates The Struggle You Know Too Well: You want direct, personalized guidance from a trader mentored by Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick rather than a generic pre-recorded webinar. How Our Mission Covers You: Our application-only 1-on-1 Mentorship pairs approved traders directly with our desk to rebuild your execution, psychology, and risk management from the ground up. Explore the Mentorship Concept Read Founder Story & Track Record Straight Answers • Zero Marketing Spin Frequently Asked Questions About Our Mission & Trading Standards Why do you emphasize "People Over Profits" so strongly? + The development goal is clear educational explanations and realistic risk discussion. Purchases and paid subscriptions have never been available; the public concept is used for browser testing and search visibility.What if I only have $500 to start trading? Am I really covered? + Small-account education is a proposed concept, not an available service or a promise of growth. Trading can exhaust a small account, and examples do not establish suitability.How do your alert-only memberships work if I can't join a live trading room? + SPX Profit Pulse and Sunday Alpha Protocol are proposed concepts for educational watchlists and scenarios. There is no active alert membership, paid subscription, or enrollment.Why can't I pay directly for 1-on-1 Mentorship on your website? + An application and fit review is a proposed design for a possible future program. Applications and paid enrollment are not currently open, and no future availability is guaranteed. Educate • Innovate • Prosper We Are the Present and the Future. We Are the Revolution! You no longer have to guess which indicator works, which guru is lying, or whether your schedule and account size can succeed. Step into a transparent trading family built for your victory. widths.mainText: HomeFree Trading ResourcesETF Stocks List Authored by Billy Ribeiro • Updated October 31, 2026 • 12 Core ETFs + All 11 S&P 500 Sectors Free Trader Resource Educate • Innovate • Prosper • People Over Profits Complete Exchange-Traded Funds (ETF) Directory • Index, Sector & Options Guide The Institutional ETF Stocks List: Master Liquidity, Sector Rotation & Options Execution. Your comprehensive reference guide to Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs). Explore the 12 most heavily traded flagship ETFs, inspect all 11 official S&P 500 GICS Sectors, compare ETFs against mutual funds, and learn how institutional desks use ETFs for intraday scalping, 9-to-5 swing trading, and $500+ small account compounding. Sector ETFs like XLK, XLE, XLF, and SMH allow 9-to-5 working professionals to trade the dominant institutional money flow with smooth technical structure and zero single-company blowup risk.What is the difference between SPY and SPX when trading S&P 500 options? + SPY is an Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) priced at roughly 1/10th the S&P 500 Index with American-style share settlement and dividend payments. SPX is the cash-settled S&P 500 Index itself (10x the notional size of SPY) with European-style exercise and US Section 1256 60/40 tax treatment. Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) are SEC- and IIROC-regulated investment vehicles that trade on stock exchanges throughout the market day, just like individual stocks. h1: Stock Indexes List
widths.mainText: HomeFree Trading ResourcesStock Indexes List 10 Global Benchmarks • S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow & VIX • ETF & Futures Proxies Market Reference Stock Indexes List Your comprehensive guide to major stock market indexes. Understand how indexes work, track market performance, and discover the best ways to gain exposure. Authored by Billy Ribeiro • Updated October 31, 2026 Featured Index S&P 500 Index The S&P 500 is a prominent stock index that tracks the 500 largest companies listed on major U.S. exchanges, such as the NYSE and NASDAQ. This index is weighted based on the total market capitalization of each company's outstanding shares, which means it offers a comprehensive representation of the overall U.S. stock market, more so than other indexes like the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) or the Russell 2000. Recognized globally as one of the most influential stock indexes, the S&P 500 is market capitalization-weighted. This indicates that companies with larger market values have a more significant impact on the index's overall performance compared to smaller companies. In essence, bigger companies exert more influence over the market's overall movement. Pro Tip: Investors aiming for exposure to large-cap stocks (such as Apple or Microsoft) might find it beneficial to invest in ETFs like VOO or IVV rather than picking individual stocks for their portfolio. To closely monitor market trends, $SPY and $ES (S&P 500 futures) are commonly used instruments. Having a chart of either SPY or SPY futures is crucial when trading stocks, as the majority of stocks tend to move in tandem with the broader market. Popular S&P 500 ETFs: SPY VOO IVV SPY Chart View on TradingView Major Stock Indexes Explore the world's most important stock market indexes and learn how to track them. Filter by region All RegionsUSUKGermanyJapanHong Kong SPX US S&P 500 Ticker: $SPX Tracks the 500 largest companies listed on major U.S. exchanges. Market capitalization-weighted, offering comprehensive representation of the U.S. stock market. 500 Companies Large-Cap Related ETFs: SPYVOOIVVDJI US Dow Jones Industrial Average Ticker: $DJI Measures the top 30 U.S. large-cap stocks. One of the oldest and most widely followed indexes, representing blue-chip companies. 30 Companies Large-Cap Related ETFs: DIACOMPQ US NASDAQ Composite Ticker: $COMPQ Includes all stocks listed on the NASDAQ exchange. Heavily weighted toward technology and growth companies. 3000 Companies All-Cap Related ETFs: QQQONEQNDX US NASDAQ 100 Ticker: $NDX Measures the top 100 largest non-financial companies listed on NASDAQ. Known for its tech-heavy composition. 100 Companies Large-Cap Related ETFs: QQQQQQMRUT US Russell 2000 Ticker: $RUT Tracks 2,000 small-cap U.S. companies. A benchmark for small-cap stock performance and economic health. 2000 Companies Small-Cap Related ETFs: IWMVTWOVIX US CBOE Volatility Index Ticker: $VIX Measures market expectations of near-term volatility. Known as the "fear gauge" of the market. N/A Volatility Related ETFs: VXXUVXYFTSE UK FTSE 100 Ticker: FTSE Tracks the 100 largest companies listed on the London Stock Exchange by market capitalization. 100 Companies Large-Cap Related ETFs: ISFVUKEDAX Germany DAX 40 Ticker: DAX Germany's premier stock index, tracking the 40 largest and most liquid companies on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange. 40 Companies Large-Cap Related ETFs: EWGDAXN225 Japan Nikkei 225 Ticker: N225 Japan's leading stock index, tracking 225 large, publicly owned companies from a wide range of industries. 225 Companies Large-Cap Related ETFs: EWJDXJHSI Hong Kong Hang Seng Index Ticker: HSI Tracks the largest companies listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, representing about 60% of total market cap. 82 Companies Large-Cap Related ETFs: EWHFXI Frequently Asked Questions Common questions about stock indexes and how to invest in them. What are the three major stock indexes? 1. S&P 500: measures 500 large-caps in U.S. stock market2. Dow Jones 30: measures the top 30 U.S. large-cap stocks3. Nasdaq 100: measures the top 100 largest non-financial companies What is the difference between a stock and an index? A stock allows investors partial ownership in a company. An index gives investors the option of investing in a basket of companies through products like ETFs, mutual funds, and derivatives. Can you invest directly in an index? An index cannot be traded or invested in directly. Many different products, such as ETFs, mutual funds, and derivatives, are available to investors to gain exposure to index performance. What are the ticker symbols for major indexes? 1. S&P 500 – SPX or $SPX2. Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) – $DJI3. Nasdaq Composite – COMPQ or $COMPQ4. NYSE Composite – (DJ)5. Russell 2000 – RUT or $RUT What is the most widely cited US stock market index? The most widely cited US stock market index is the S&P 500, which measures 500 large-cap stocks and is considered the best representation of the overall U.S. stock market. Ready to Start Trading? widths.title: 0DTE SPX Options Strategy Guide | Revolution Trading Pros
h1: 0DTE SPX Options Strategy Guide
widths.mainText: Home / Blog / SPX Options / 0DTE SPX Options Strategy Guide SPX Options 16 min read 0DTE SPX Options Strategy Guide Compare SPX, XSP and SPY, work through three defined-risk spreads, and separate gamma estimates from evidence of a trading edge. Billy Ribeiro Head Trader & Founder Published November 5, 2026 0DTE Options,Risk Management Figure 1. Original hypothetical price-map illustration. Levels are teaching examples, not live prices, measured dealer inventory or trading signals. Table of Contents 1. What 0DTE changes about the trade 2. SPX, XSP and SPY: settlement and tax differences 3. Gamma exposure: useful model, incomplete inventory 4. Three spread structures and what their math proves 5. Build a session plan instead of a universal time signal 6. A chart study that does not pretend to measure GEX 7. Margin eligibility and a consistent loss budget 8. Next steps and risk disclosure A 0DTE SPX options strategy starts with the contract, the payoff and the amount you can lose. A gamma chart can help organize a hypothesis, but it cannot establish dealer inventory, predict a closing price or turn a spread into a profitable system. This guide separates exchange facts from model assumptions and works through three defined-risk structures. All index levels, premiums, fills and chart paths below are hypothetical teaching examples. SPX 7,700 is a convenient arithmetic baseline, not a verified November 5 market quote. Figures show original illustrations, not exchange screenshots, backtests or trading results. 1. What 0DTE changes about the trade Direct answer: A 0DTE option expires on the trading day you enter it. Near-the-money contracts can change value sharply as expiration approaches. Defined-risk spreads cap the theoretical terminal loss of an intact position, but short holding periods leave little time to recover from an entry error, a spread widening or an unexpected announcement. Cboe reported a record 3.6 million average daily SPX 0DTE contracts for October 2026 in its November 4 volume release. That is trading activity, not a count of unique positions or net directional exposure. The rounded release does not establish an exact monthly percentage share; dividing rounded totals would create false precision. The Cboe 0DTE resource page separately displays 59% for SPX volume, 48% for XSP volume and 54% annual growth since 2016. Those page-level statistics are not labeled as October 2026 readings. Keep their scope separate from the dated monthly release. Neither source demonstrates that a particular entry window or strategy has positive expectancy. Three sensitivities matter. Delta describes an option's local price response to the underlying. The Options Industry Council explains gamma as delta's response to an underlying move. Theta describes sensitivity to time passing, holding other inputs fixed. Near expiration, an option close to its strike can become especially sensitive to a small underlying move; an option far from its strike behaves differently. There is no universal curve in which every option's gamma rises through the afternoon. Before looking for a setup, identify today's expiration, the settlement convention, the scheduled announcements and the latest time your broker permits an exit. A decision to skip the session is a complete trading decision. High turnover on an exchange does not create an obligation to participate. 2. SPX, XSP and SPY: settlement and tax differences Direct answer: SPX and XSP are European-style, cash-settled index options. SPY options deliver ETF shares and can be exercised before expiration. At a hypothetical SPX level of 7,700, one SPX contract represents $770,000 of underlying notional; XSP is one-tenth the index scale. Notional exposure is different from premium paid and maximum spread loss. Contract mechanics to verify before selecting an expiration Feature SPX / SPXW XSP SPY options Underlying S&P 500 Index One-tenth SPX index scale SPDR S&P 500 ETF shares Exercise and delivery European; cash European; cash American; normally 100 shares per standard contract Multiplier $100 per index point $100 per XSP point Normally 100 shares; verify adjustments Expiration selection Distinguish traditional AM settlement from PM-settled SPXW Verify PM settlement and series Check exercise instructions and broker cutoff Potential tax category Qualifying non-equity option under Section 1256 Qualifying non-equity option under Section 1256 Generally equity-option treatment Cboe's SPX fact sheet describes the settlement calculation. Its contract specifications distinguish SPXW expiration trading, normally ending at 4:00 p.m. Eastern, from traditional SPX. Half-day expiration trading normally ends at 1:00 p.m. Eastern. For smaller-product education, see the small-accounts room. These links do not substantiate a particular trading result or a promise of real-time dealer inventory. Read the service descriptions and risk disclosure before deciding whether an offering fits your needs. Hypothetical calculations are not actual performance. SPX, XSP and SPY: settlement and tax differences 3. Gamma exposure: useful model, incomplete inventory 4. Three spread structures and what their math proves 5. What 0DTE changes about the trade Direct answer: A 0DTE option expires on the trading day you enter it. Near-the-money contracts can change value sharply as expiration approaches. Defined-risk spreads cap the theoretical terminal loss of an intact position, but short holding periods leave little time to recover from an entry error, a spread widening or an unexpected announcement. Cboe reported a record 3.6 million average daily SPX 0DTE contracts for October 2026 in its November 4 volume release. That is trading activity, not a count of unique positions or net directional exposure. The rounded release does not establish an exact monthly percentage share; dividing rounded totals would create false precision. The Cboe 0DTE resource page separately displays 59% for SPX volume, 48% for XSP volume and 54% annual growth since 2016. Those page-level statistics are not labeled as October 2026 readings. Keep their scope separate from the dated monthly release. Neither source demonstrates that a particular entry window or strategy has positive expectancy. Three sensitivities matter. Delta describes an option's local price response to the underlying. The Options Industry Council explains gamma as delta's response to an underlying move. Theta describes sensitivity to time passing, holding other inputs fixed. Near expiration, an option close to its strike can become especially sensitive to a small underlying move; an option far from its strike behaves differently. There is no universal curve in which every option's gamma rises through the afternoon. Before looking for a setup, identify today's expiration, the settlement convention, the scheduled announcements and the latest time your broker permits an exit. A decision to skip the session is a complete trading decision. High turnover on an exchange does not create an obligation to participate. 2. At a hypothetical SPX level of 7,700, one SPX contract represents $770,000 of underlying notional; XSP is one-tenth the index scale. Notional exposure is different from premium paid and maximum spread loss. Its contract specifications distinguish SPXW expiration trading, normally ending at 4:00 p.m. Eastern, from traditional SPX. Half-day expiration trading normally ends at 1:00 p.m. Eastern. A broker may impose an earlier operational cutoff. The XSP product page documents the smaller index scale. Cash settlement removes share-delivery exposure, not loss risk. After-hours movement and exercise instructions can leave an unexpected stock position. Schwab's expiration checklist explains exercise and broker deadlines. A delta-hedged dealer who is long gamma generally needs to sell underlying after a rise and buy after a fall, all else equal. A short-gamma dealer generally needs the opposite adjustment. The sign must represent the modeled dealer holding, not simply whether the contract is a call or a put. For an arithmetic-only example, gamma 0.014, 45,000 contracts, multiplier 100 and spot 7,700 produce $37,352,700,000 per 1% move. That large number assumes every contract belongs on the same signed side. It is a local approximation with gamma held fixed across the shock, not a forecast that dealers must execute that dollar amount in futures. Near expiry, gamma can change materially during the move.
